title: Red-helm sergeant
summary: The squad-leader treatment: the sergeant only, not the nine troopers that share his box.

target.description: Example Miniatures Vanguard squad sergeant - bare head, power fist, 32mm plastic

steps.title: Rank markings
steps.instruction: Basecoat the rank markings on the bare head in Signal Red so the model reads as the leader across the table.

steps.title: Power fist
steps.instruction: Metallic the power fist with Cold Steel, then wash the recesses.

org.brushcodex.subject:identity.qualifier: sergeant variant only - bare head and power fist; not an ordinary squad body

org.brushcodex.product:sourceContext.note: Nine ordinary troopers and one sergeant ship under this single SKU.
